name: smwgraphics-actraiser-death-heim-boss-rush
title: ActRaiser - Death Heim (Boss Rush)
description:
One of Death Heim's backgrounds, seen while The Master is refighting the main bosses of the game.

Use it with parallaxing scrolling to make the best use of this background.

The eclipse uses the back area color, so it can be used with layer 3 behind the layer 2.

A good fit for mountain levels.
